body.title: India is witnessing strong growth for Made-in-India vehicles: Piyush Goyal
body.summary: India's automotive sector has demonstrated remarkable resilience and momentum, recording a stellar 23 per cent year-on-year growth in the for May 2026. Data released indicated that nearly 4.4 lakh units were sold during the month, a performance credited to robust domestic demand and the strengthening of the "Make in India" manufacturing ecosystem.

body.title: 92,000 women become 'lakhpati didis' in Ranchi, says Union MoS Sanjay Seth
body.summary: Ranchi (Jharkhand) [India], June 6 (ANI): Union Minister of State Sanjay Seth highlighted the significant strides made in women’s economic independence under the central government’s initiatives, asserting that over 90,000 women in Ranchi have become ‘Lakhpati Didis’.

body.title: RBI imposes penalty on Canara Bank
body.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Friday (June 5) said it has imposed a penalty of ₹1.8 lakh on Canara Bank for non-compliance with certain provisions, including those related to Know Your Customer norms. After a supervisory evaluation (ISE 2025) of the bank with reference to its financial position as on March 31, 2025, the RBI found that Canara Bank did not upload KYC records of certain customers onto Central KYC Records Registry (CKYCR) within the prescribed timeline.

body.title: India’s changing relationship with gold: From ownership to financial utility
body.summary: India’s households possess around 30,000 tonnes of gold holdings, which places them among the largest owners of gold in the world. However, the majority of the holdings have been economically inactive assets, stored either in bank locker facilities or household safes.

body.title: E85 fuel to get Rs 20/litre cheaper as India ramps up ethanol push
body.summary: India’s clean fuel journey is stepping up a gear, with state-run oil firms gearing up to roll out E85 petrol at a discounted price across the country. State-run oil marketing companies will offer E85 fuel at a discount of Rs 20 per litre compared with E20 petrol to make up for the biofuel’s lower energy content, petroleum and natural gas minister Hardeep Singh Puri said after inaugurating an E85 dispensing facility at a petrol pump in Delhi.

body.title: Adani Ports incorporates UAE-based step-down subsidiary for marine operations
body.summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone (APSEZ) has incorporated a new step-down wholly owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates as part of its marine business expansion strategy. The newly incorporated entity will be engaged in ship management and operations.

body.title: KPMG forensic review says IDFC First Bank Chandigarh fraud an isolated incident
body.summary: MUMBAI: Private sector lender IDFC First Bank said a forensic review by KPMG found that the ₹ 646 crore fraud uncovered at its Chandigarh branch earlier this year was an isolated incident involving collusion between branch employees, customer representatives and third parties.

body.title: Board of SpiceJet approves change in registered office
body.summary: The board of SpiceJet at its meeting held on 05 June 2026 has approved the change of the Company's Registered Office from “Indira Gandhi International Airport, Terminal 1D, New Delhi – 110037” to “505, 5th Floor, Caddie Commercial Tower, Aerocity (DIAL), New Delhi – 110037”, within the local limits of New Delhi, with immediate effect.
